articles.title: 10 Tech Stocks Soar In The New Rally — None Are Magnificent 7
articles.mainIdea: 10 Tech Stocks Soar In The New Rally — None Are Magnificent 7
articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: 10 Tech Stocks Soar In The New Rally — None Are Magnificent 7. The S&P 500 is on fire — but no thanks to the Magnificent 7. The 10 top S&P 500 stocks since the year's low on March 30 are all in the tech sector. But not one of them, including Intel, Sandisk and Coherent, are part of the Magnificent 7 mega-cap tech giants that ruled in past years. Related tickers mentioned: COHR, INTC, NVDA, SNDK, SPY, ^GSPC.
